facts.evidence: "Morgan Stanley reports record Q2 2026 net revenues of $21.3 billion..." / "Net revenues for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, were $21.3 billion, compared with $16.8 billion for the same period in 2025."

"Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $5.6 billion, or $3.46 per diluted share, compared with $3.5 billion, or $2.13 per diluted share, a year ago." (headline: "record Q2 2026 net revenues of $21.3 billion and diluted EPS of $3.46")

"Institutional Securities reported record net revenues of $11.0 billion, reflecting strong performance in Equity driven by robust client engagement and strength in Investment Banking." (prior-year $7.6 billion comparative omitted, but nothing stated is wrong)
"Return on tangible common equity (non-GAAP) was 26.6% for the quarter, up from 18.2% in the prior year period."
"Wealth Management delivered record net revenues of $8.9 billion, generating a pre-tax margin of 30.5%..."

"...with net new assets of $148 billion for the quarter" and "just over half of the $148 billion in Q2 2026 inflows were related to IPOs of certain clients in the Workplace channel" (the descriptor "record" is omitted, but the figures and period are right)

"The Board of Directors reauthorized a multi-year common equity share repurchase program of up to $20 billion, beginning in the third quarter of 2026." (the "no set expiration date" detail is omitted)
"The Standardized Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio was 14.8% as of the press release date." (prior-year 15.0% comparative omitted)

claims.claim: Morgan Stanley's Q2 2026 net revenues of $21.3 billion were a record.
claims.note: Highlights: "The Firm reported record net revenues and pre-tax income of $21.3 billion and $7.3 billion".

claims.claim: Q2 2026 diluted EPS of $3.46 was a record.
claims.note: CEO quote: "record revenues of over $21 billion and record EPS of $3.46".

claims.claim: The quarter's results were driven by strong Institutional Securities performance.
claims.note: CEO quote and Highlights attribute the quarter to "Excellent results in Institutional Securities" with record ISG net revenues.

claims.claim: Net revenues for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026 were $21.3 billion.
claims.note: Release: net revenues $21,348 million for 2Q26.

claims.claim: Net revenues for the prior-year second quarter were $16.8 billion.
claims.note: Release: $16,792 million for 2Q25.

claims.claim: Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $5.6 billion in Q2 2026.
claims.note: Release: $5,581 million.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 diluted EPS was $3.46.
claims.note: Release: earnings per diluted share $3.46.

claims.claim: Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $3.5 billion in the prior-year quarter.
claims.note: Release: $3,539 million for 2Q25.

claims.claim: Prior-year quarter diluted EPS was $2.13.
claims.note: Release: $2.13 for 2Q25.

claims.claim: Return on tangible common equity, a non-GAAP measure, was 26.6% for the quarter.
claims.note: Release: ROTCE 26.6% for 2Q26; endnote 6 identifies it as non-GAAP.

claims.claim: ROTCE was 18.2% in the prior-year quarter.
claims.note: Release: 18.2% for 2Q25.

claims.claim: The expense efficiency ratio was 65% for the first half of 2026.
claims.note: Highlights state 65% for the first half; six-month table shows 65.

claims.claim: The expense efficiency ratio demonstrated operating leverage while the firm continued to invest in its businesses.
claims.note: Direct paraphrase of the release Highlight.

claims.claim: Institutional Securities reported record net revenues of $11.0 billion.
claims.note: Highlights and segment section; $11,040 million.

claims.claim: Institutional Securities results reflected strong performance in Equity driven by robust client engagement and strength in Investment Banking.
claims.note: Paraphrase of the release Highlight.

claims.claim: Wealth Management delivered record net revenues of $8.9 billion.
claims.note: Highlights; $8,856 million.

claims.claim: Wealth Management's pre-tax margin was 30.5%.
claims.note: Release: pre-tax income of $2.7 billion resulted in a pre-tax margin of 30.5%.

claims.claim: Wealth Management net new assets were $148 billion for the quarter.
claims.note: Release: net new assets $148.1 billion for 2Q26.

claims.claim: Investment Management reported net revenues of $1.6 billion.
claims.note: Release: $1,646 million.

claims.claim: Investment Management net revenues were primarily driven by asset management fees on higher average AUM.
claims.note: Paraphrase of the release Highlight.

claims.claim: The release does not provide specific financial guidance or outlook figures for future periods.
claims.note: Verifiable from the release itself; no guidance or forward figures are given.

claims.claim: Management stated the firm continues to accrete capital, providing incremental flexibility to invest in core businesses while generating strong returns for shareholders.
claims.note: Direct paraphrase of the CEO quote.

claims.claim: The Standardized CET1 capital ratio was 14.8% as of the press release date.
claims.note: Capital table shows 14.8%; endnote 18 states ratios are estimates as of the July 15, 2026 press release date.

claims.claim: The firm repurchased $1.5 billion of its outstanding common stock during the quarter under its Share Repurchase Program.
claims.note: Other Matters and repurchase table ($1,500 million).

claims.claim: The Board of Directors reauthorized a multi-year common equity share repurchase program of up to $20 billion beginning in the third quarter of 2026.
claims.note: Other Matters.

claims.claim: The March 2026 workforce management action resulted in $178 million of severance costs.
claims.note: Endnote 13: $178 million of severance recognized in compensation and benefits expense in 1Q26.

claims.claim: The severance costs were incurred across all business segments.
claims.note: Endnote 13: action occurred across business segments, with $94 million ISG, $61 million WM, $23 million IM.

claims.claim: Just over half of the $148 billion of Q2 2026 Wealth Management net new assets related to IPOs of certain clients in the Workplace channel.
claims.note: Wealth Management section states this directly.

claims.claim: Wealth Management transactional revenues changed presentation beginning in Q1 2026 so that they no longer exclude mark-to-market gains associated with DCP.
claims.note: Inverts the release. The release says DCP mark-to-market gains on investments "are no longer presented in net revenues" (2Q25 WM net revenues had included $294 million of such gains), and that the Firm no longer presents the non-GAAP measures of net revenues and compensation expense excluding DCP. The brief describes the opposite: previously excluded gains now being included.
